name: @pipeworx/mcp-rescuegroups

tools.name: rescuegroups_adoptable
tools.description: Search adoptable animals listed by rescues and shelters on RescueGroups.org: name, breed, age, sex, size, temperament flags (good with kids/dogs/cats), photos, and the listing organization. Filter by species, postal-code radius, breed, sex, age group and size. Requires your own RescueGroups API key. Example: rescuegroups_adoptable({ species: "dogs", postalcode: "15206", miles: 50, limit: 5, _apiKey: "your-key" })

species.description: Species to search, spelled plural and lower-case as RescueGroups does (e.g. "dogs", "cats", "rabbits", "horses"). Omit to search every species at once. Call rescuegroups_species for the live list.

postalcode.description: US or Canadian postal/zip code to search around, e.g. "15206". Requires `miles` or `kilometers`. RescueGroups uses the centre of the postal code, so this is less precise than lat/lon.

lat.description: Latitude to search around. Use with `lon` and `miles`/`kilometers`. More precise than `postalcode`.

lon.description: Longitude to search around. Use with `lat`.

miles.description: Radius in miles for a distance search. Provide exactly one of `miles` or `kilometers`; the returned `distance` field is in the same unit.

kilometers.description: Radius in kilometres for a distance search. Provide exactly one of `miles` or `kilometers`.

breed.description: Breed to match, e.g. "Beagle". Matched as a substring against the animal's breed string, so "Retriever" matches "Golden Retriever". Call rescuegroups_breeds for exact names.

age_group.description: General age band as RescueGroups classifies it.

good_with_kids.description: Only animals flagged good with children.

good_with_dogs.description: Only animals flagged OK with other dogs.

good_with_cats.description: Only animals flagged OK with cats.

views.description: Extra RescueGroups "views" to stack onto the search: "haspic" (has at least one photo), "isspecialneeds", "isneedingfoster", "urgent", "iscourtesylisting", "attending" (attending an adoption event).

org_id.description: Restrict the search to one organization id (see rescuegroups_organizations).

include_adopted.description: Search already-adopted animals instead of available ones. Default false (only animals available for adoption).

sort.description: Field to sort by, prefixed with "-" for descending, e.g. "-animals.updatedDate" (most recently updated first) or "animals.name". On a distance search "distance" sorts nearest-first. Fully-qualified names like "animals.name" are what the API expects.

page.description: Page of results, starting at 1. Use with `limit`; the response `pagination` block tells you how many pages there are.

_apiKey.description: Your own RescueGroups API key. Pipeworx has no shared key for this pack. Request a free public API key at https://rescuegroups.org/services/request-an-api-key/ — a short form (name, email, organisation, site URL). It is open to individual developers: "not incorporated" is an accepted answer and you do not need to be a rescue or shelter. RescueGroups staff review it and email the key back, so it is not instant. Then pass the key as the `_apiKey` argument.

tools.name: rescuegroups_animal
tools.description: Full record for one adoptable animal by RescueGroups id — description, all photos, breeds, adoption fee, temperament and the listing rescue/shelter with its contact details. Requires your own RescueGroups API key. Example: rescuegroups_animal({ animal_id: "8013243", _apiKey: "your-key" })

animal_id.description: RescueGroups animal id, as returned in the `id` field by rescuegroups_adoptable.

_apiKey.description: Your own RescueGroups API key. Request a free public API key at https://rescuegroups.org/services/request-an-api-key/ — a short form (name, email, organisation, site URL). It is open to individual developers: "not incorporated" is an accepted answer and you do not need to be a rescue or shelter. RescueGroups staff review it and email the key back, so it is not instant. Then pass the key as the `_apiKey` argument.

tools.name: rescuegroups_organizations
tools.description: Find animal rescues and shelters with RescueGroups.org accounts: name, type (Rescue or Shelter), address, phone, email, website, adoption process, areas served and services. Filter by postal-code radius, state or name. Requires your own RescueGroups API key. Example: rescuegroups_organizations({ postalcode: "15206", miles: 25, limit: 5, _apiKey: "your-key" })

postalcode.description: US or Canadian postal/zip code to search around. Requires `miles` or `kilometers`.

lat.description: Latitude to search around. Use with `lon`.

lon.description: Longitude to search around. Use with `lat`.

miles.description: Radius in miles. Provide exactly one of `miles` or `kilometers`.

kilometers.description: Radius in kilometres. Provide exactly one of `miles` or `kilometers`.

state.description: Two-letter state or province code, e.g. "PA".

type.description: Restrict to rescues or to shelters. Omit for both.

org_id.description: Fetch one organization by id instead of searching.

sort.description: Field to sort by, "-" prefixed for descending, e.g. "orgs.name". On a distance search "distance" sorts nearest-first.

_apiKey.description: Your own RescueGroups API key. Request a free public API key at https://rescuegroups.org/services/request-an-api-key/ — a short form (name, email, organisation, site URL). It is open to individual developers: "not incorporated" is an accepted answer and you do not need to be a rescue or shelter. RescueGroups staff review it and email the key back, so it is not instant. Then pass the key as the `_apiKey` argument.

tools.name: rescuegroups_species
tools.description: The species vocabulary RescueGroups uses — singular, plural and young-animal words for each species it lists. Use it to get the exact `species` value rescuegroups_adoptable expects. Requires your own RescueGroups API key. Example: rescuegroups_species({ _apiKey: "your-key" })

limit.description: Rows per page, 1-250. Default 250 (the whole list is small).

_apiKey.description: Your own RescueGroups API key. Request a free public API key at https://rescuegroups.org/services/request-an-api-key/ — a short form (name, email, organisation, site URL). It is open to individual developers: "not incorporated" is an accepted answer and you do not need to be a rescue or shelter. RescueGroups staff review it and email the key back, so it is not instant. Then pass the key as the `_apiKey` argument.

tools.name: rescuegroups_breeds
tools.description: Breeds RescueGroups recognises for a species, for building an exact breed filter. Requires your own RescueGroups API key. Example: rescuegroups_breeds({ species: "dogs", limit: 50, _apiKey: "your-key" })

species.description: Species whose breeds to list, plural and lower-case, e.g. "dogs". Omit for every breed across all species (thousands of rows — page it).

limit.description: Rows per page. This endpoint allows up to 10000. Default 250.

_apiKey.description: Your own RescueGroups API key. Request a free public API key at https://rescuegroups.org/services/request-an-api-key/ — a short form (name, email, organisation, site URL). It is open to individual developers: "not incorporated" is an accepted answer and you do not need to be a rescue or shelter. RescueGroups staff review it and email the key back, so it is not instant. Then pass the key as the `_apiKey` argument.
